body.x: Monster participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced various audio equipment that boasts the best sound quality.

Based on the great success of Monster Blaster, Monster created 6 models used for mainly portable outdoor party music. Blaster and Ravebox are characterized with great LED built-in lighting and enable people to enjoy colorful festivals. Additional models of Monster Blaster product family include Nitro, Dynamite, Firecracker, and Battleship and all the models wirelessly deliver a unique listening experience that is dynamic with tight, deep base and Pure Monster Sound ™.

Monster Clarity Designer Series wireless headphones have amazing functions such as state-of-the-art swipe controls for play, pause, and volume control, excellent wireless function(apt-X), ultra-soft ear cushions, adjustable headband, active echo suppression technology, a built-in high-quality microphone for clear calls, a 24-hour battery life, and a low-battery warning tone and display.

Monster Blaster ™ JP1000 Classic Rock Edition, designed and tuned by rock music legend Joe Perry for Monster, brings all the music to life. This product is a boom box recreated with modern design and the latest wireless technology. Deep bass through Power Bass Powered sub-woofer changes the atmosphere at any time without being disturbed by any environment of the place.
(Photo: Monster Blaster ™ JP1000 Classic Rock Edition)

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
